newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Argenta Finance buys 32 pct Venezuela's Telcel.
newsitem.headline: Argenta Finance buys 32 pct Venezuela's Telcel.

text.p: Argenta Finance Ltd, based in the British Virgin Islands, bought Friday Comunicaciones Telefonica S.A. (Comtel), which owns a 32 percent in Venezuela's leading cellular telephone company Telcel, a Venezuelan Electronic Stock Exchange official said.
Comtel, which was purchased for 71.245 billion bolivars ($150 million), was previously owned by the Cisneros Group of companies, one of Latin America's leading family businesses.
The official, who asked not to be named, told Reuters the sale of Comtel had been carried out as a cross trade by local brokerage Chase Valores.
Telcel, founded in 1991, controls approximately 60 percent of Venezuela's mobile phone users' market.
Before the sale of Comtel the Cisneros Group owned a total of 40 percent of Telcel. The rest is owned by U.S. telecommunications company BellSouth Corp
The Cisneros Group recently broke a franchise agreement with Pepsi Inc to join forces with Coca-Cola Corp to bottle and distribute soft drinks in Venezuela.
